subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu typing indicator starts only after first reply payload

question: Should accepted Feishu turns create an early visible streaming-card preview, or should OpenClaw retain reaction-only feedback and document its client-visibility limitation?
rationale: The reporter’s real-client evidence shows that the original reaction-based premise does not reliably meet the UX goal, while the alternative intersects an open streaming-card lifecycle failure and therefore changes the intended product behavior rather than merely moving an existing callback.

options.title: Specify and implement an early preview card
options.body: Create a bounded preview-card lifecycle after acceptance, with explicit cleanup for errors, timeouts, and no-content turns, and resolve the adjacent empty-card invariant first.

options.title: Keep reaction-only feedback
options.body: Retain the existing feedback mechanism and close this as unsupported client-visible behavior unless Feishu offers another reliable non-card status surface.

options.title: Treat this with the card-lifecycle issue
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91195 the shared design discussion and define one card start/settle contract before either repair is implemented.

recommendation.title: Specify and implement an early preview card
recommendation.body: Create a bounded preview-card lifecycle after acceptance, with explicit cleanup for errors, timeouts, and no-content turns, and resolve the adjacent empty-card invariant first.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has the only supplied real-client evidence distinguishing API success from visible Feishu feedback; a Feishu area owner should validate the eventual product choice.
